exposure: Clindamycin or metronidazole intrapartum antibiotic therapy
outcome: Postpartum maternal infection (composite of endometritis and surgical site infection)
cohort: The study included 1105 women with presumptive chorioamnionitis who delivered by cesarean delivery and received a base regimen of ampicillin or penicillin with gentamicin for chorioamnionitis.
finding: Among women with chorioamnionitis delivering by cesarean, additional intrapartum antibiotic therapy with cefazolin was associated with lower odds of postpartum infectious morbidity, primarily surgical site infection, compared to clindamycin or metronidazole.
